title: The main functional groups
caption: A functional group is the atom or group of atoms that gives a family its reactions. Each two- or three-carbon example has its group shaded.
alt: Eight small molecules: ethanol, bromoethane, ethanal, propanone, ethanoic acid, methyl ethanoate, ethylamine and ethanamide, each with its functional group shaded.
description: alcohol: CCO with the alcohol group shaded.
halogenoalkane: CCBr with the halogenoalkane group shaded.
aldehyde: CC=O with the aldehyde group shaded.
ketone: CC(C)=O with the ketone group shaded.
carboxylic acid: CC(=O)O with the carboxylic acid group shaded.
ester: CC(=O)OC with the ester group shaded.
amine: CCN with the primary amine group shaded.
amide: CC(N)=O with the amide group shaded.
